notes.title: Menu Refresh & Minor Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

A small update has just been deployed. We've given the main menu a fresh coat of paint!

In this patch, you'll notice a visual overhaul of the main menu for a more polished and atmospheric first impression. We've updated the look and feel to better align with the post-apocalyptic world of Trytka before you even dive into the game.

No gameplay changes this time around – just a little something to enhance the view from the starting line.

Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: The Guidance Update is Live! New Progression System, Pickaxe & Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I'm excited to release a new update for "Trytka" that I've been working on, focused directly on your feedback!

Here are the details:

Your Next Step is Clear! Feeling a bit lost on what to build or where to go next? I've implemented a new system that shows you exactly what you need to do, one step at a time. My goal is to make the progression feel more natural so you can get to the fun stuff faster.

The Pickaxe has Arrived! You asked for more ways to gather materials, and here it is! The pickaxe is now available to craft. Get out there and start breaking some rocks!

Bug Squashed: I managed to track down and fix a frustrating bug. Thanks to everyone who reported it and helped me find it!

Thank you for playing "Trytka" and for all your amazing support. It means the world to me. Tell me what you think about the update!

notes.title: Update is Live! New Birch Wardrobe & Quality of Life Features!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630010/b6c5fa6c89d9d8900b05bc4eaecc8c891b4d990b.png"]Hello, Survivors!

I am excited to push out a new update for Trytka! We're continuing to work hard on improving the world and your experience within it. This patch introduces a brand new storage item, some subtle but welcome visual upgrades, and a key quality-of-life feature you've been asking for.

Here’s what’s new:



New Craftable Item: The Birch Wardrobe



You can now bring a touch of rustic style to your base with the brand-new Birch Wardrobe! This sturdy and spacious storage solution is perfect for organizing your hard-earned loot, gear, and resources. Head to your crafting menu to see what you'll need to build one.



Map Visual Improvements



We believe that even small details matter. As you continue to explore the world, you may notice some minor visual enhancements and polish across the map. We are constantly working on making the environment more immersive and will continue to do so in future updates.



Minimap Marker for Your Terrain Flag!



Navigating back to your base or a key location just got much easier! We've implemented a highly requested feature: your placed Terrain Flag will now permanently display a marker on your minimap. No more getting lost on the way back home after a long resource run!

We're incredibly grateful for your continued support and feedback. Please let us know what you think of the new additions in the comments below or on our community forums. Your insights are invaluable as we continue to develop and expand Trytka.

Stay safe out there

notes.title: Bug Fix Update: Squashing Those Pesky Issues!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I've just rolled out a new update focused on fixing some of the bugs you've reported. Thanks so much for your patience and for helping us make the game even better!

Here's what's been addressed in this patch:

Wave System Fixed! We've ironed out the kinks in the wave system, so you should now experience smoother and more consistent enemy encounters.

Vehicle Glitch Patched! We've also resolved a specific bug related to the car. Your ride should now be back to normal and behave as expected.

We're constantly working to improve your gaming experience, and your feedback is incredibly valuable. If you encounter any new issues or have further suggestions, please don't hesitate to let us know!

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: The Vehicle Update is Here! Get Ready for a Whole New Ride!
notes.notes:
Get behind the wheel, because everything about driving in our game has changed!

We've just launched the Vehicle Overhaul Update, completely rebuilding our vehicle mechanics from the ground up.

From now on, you'll experience a much more realistic and player-friendly driving model. Controls are tighter, physics are smarter, and the fun is bigger than ever.

Jump in-game and feel the difference for yourself!

See you on the road!

notes.title: Fix Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're excited to roll out a new patch for Trytka today, bringing several important fixes and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. We've been listening to your feedback and appreciate your continued support!

This update addresses the following:

Tutorial Image Fixes: We've corrected an issue where some tutorial images were not displaying correctly, ensuring new players have a clear and accurate guide to the game's mechanics.

Drone Shot Sound Restoration: The sound effects for drone shots have been fully restored and optimized, providing the intended auditory feedback during combat.

Minor UI/Menu Polish: You'll notice several small, cosmetic refinements to the game's menus, aimed at improving overall aesthetic consistency and user experience.

We believe these changes will significantly improve the overall quality of life within Trytka. We're always working to make the game better, and your feedback is invaluable.

Thank you for playing!
